services.title: Services
services.intro: From a single room to a complete project – take as much interior design support as you need, in person or online.
services.cta: Not sure which service fits? Send a message and we'll figure it out together.

interior.title: Interior Design
interior.text: Colours, materials, furniture and lighting designed as one coherent whole – around your lifestyle, your budget and the room's real dimensions.

render.title: 3D Visualization & Rendering
render.text: Photorealistic 3D renders show you the finished space before any work begins, so every decision is made with confidence.

plan.title: 2D Space Planning
plan.text: A measured layout fixes the position and size of every piece of furniture, so you shop knowing exactly what fits.

commercial.title: Commercial Interiors
commercial.text: Restaurants, clinics and offices that reflect your brand and are planned around how guests and staff actually move.

exterior.title: Exterior & Façade Design
exterior.text: Façade design for residential and commercial buildings, plus floor plan visuals that support the sales process.

online.title: Online 1:1 Consultation
online.text: A one-hour video call to work through your questions with an interior designer – wherever you are.

packages.title: Packages
packages.intro: Five packages, from a short consultation to a complete home design. We'll settle the details together on WhatsApp.
packages.note: All online packages are available anywhere in Türkiye and Northern Cyprus. Prices are per room.

compare.title: Render → Reality
compare.intro: What you approve on screen should be what you walk into. Drag the line to compare the 3D render with the finished space.
compare.sliderAria: {name}: slider comparing the render with the built result
compare.cta: Your space can start on screen and end up real, too.

projects.title: Projects
projects.intro: Homes, a restaurant, a clinic, a façade – a selection of projects, all designed by me.
projects.cta: Seen something you like? I can design something similar for you.
projects.detailCtaText: Send me your measurements and ideas on WhatsApp and we'll find the right package together.

process.title: Process
process.intro: Four clear steps from your first message to delivery.
process.cta: It starts with a short message.

1.title: Discovery call
1.text: You message me on WhatsApp; we talk through your space, your expectations and your budget, and choose the right package.

2.title: Measurements & brief
2.text: You share measurements, photos and examples you like. For online projects I guide you through measuring the space.

3.title: Concept, plan & 3D design
3.text: I prepare the layout and the 3D design, and we refine it together through the included revisions.

4.title: Delivery & implementation support
4.text: You receive the renders, drawings and product lists – and I stay available for questions while the work is carried out.

about.title: About
about.p1: Hi, I'm Ayşenur. I'm a freelance interior designer, creating homes and commercial spaces as yilmazkan Interior Design.
about.p2: I'm based in Lefkoşa (Nicosia) and İzmir, and take on projects online from anywhere in Türkiye and Northern Cyprus. I'm drawn to clean lines, warm tones and natural textures – and every design starts with the person who will live in the space.
about.p3: Every project on this site is my own work. For some of them you can see the render and the built result side by side.

educationItems.2: İzmir Kâtip Çelebi University – Dental Technology

contact.title: Contact
contact.intro: I work online with clients anywhere in Türkiye and Northern Cyprus. WhatsApp is the quickest way – a few sentences about your space are enough.
contact.whatsappText: Tell me about your space, its measurements and what you have in mind – we'll plan the rest together.

whatsapp.general: Hello Ayşenur, I found you through your website and would like to know more about your interior design services.
whatsapp.project: Hello Ayşenur, I saw "{name}" on your website and would like to talk about a similar project.
